title: Misleading Dimensions
text:
Misleading Dimensions. This was stated as having a top ring circumference of 12''3/8 and it was barely 11''
Too bad. The neon orange is a SWELL color!
The material is fine,I'm sure it would've been durable&easy to clean.
But be warned~measure you cup first!
